name: Jellyfin to Jellyfin
description: Mirrors remote Jellyfin libraries into local .strm trees and proxies playback, without downloading media.
overview: Point this plugin at one or more remote Jellyfin servers and it writes .strm/.nfo files plus artwork into a path your own server can index, then streams the original file through the local server so your users can browse and play remote content from your own libraries.

versions.changelog: Log in with a remote user instead of an API key. Jellyfin API keys are server-wide and always administrator level; the plugin now authenticates as a regular user (POST /Users/AuthenticateByName), caches the session token in memory, retries on 401 and discovers libraries through GET /UserViews. The password is never written to .strm files and no secret travels in a URL anymore: /api/test and /api/libraries are POST with a JSON body. Breaking: the per-instance ApiKey setting is gone - configure a user name and password instead (a non-admin account that sees the libraries you mirror is enough). The mirror now only contains items that account can actually play, so dead database entries no longer produce .strm files that answer 404.

Removed-item cleanup: new per-instance 'Remove stale .strm/.nfo files' option deletes mirror files whose source item is gone (and prunes the folders left empty) after a successful sync, and the report shows 'staleRemoved'. The pass never runs when a listing is empty or an item failed, and it only touches generated .strm/.nfo files plus artwork when artwork download is enabled.
